what: OASF 1.1.0 skill placement from name+description; agreement with the task-79 proposal (data/catalogue/oasf-skill-tags-proposal-13579.json) excluding reviewed=='skip'
caveat: The reference is itself a model's reading of the same truncated descriptions; only the 62 low-confidence rows were looked at again (reviewed=ok). These numbers are agreement with that proposal, not accuracy against an independent truth. Margin thresholds are read off the same 656 rows they are measured on: no held-out split.

Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5.queryPrefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

bm25.tokeniser: lowercase [a-z0-9]+, small stopword list, suffix strip ing/ies/es/ed/s

definitions.skillText: name with - and _ as spaces, '. ', description from skill-facts.json
definitions.nodeText: caption. description. ancestor captions nearest first
definitions.nodeSubtreeText: nodeText plus every descendant caption (used only by *-subtree variants)
definitions.flat: argmax over all 513 nodes (514 with design)
definitions.hier-stop: pick best level-1, then best child; stop when the current node outscores every child
definitions.hier-leaf: same, but always descend to a leaf
definitions.*-subtree: hierarchical, each decision scored against nodeSubtreeText
definitions.design: adds node '602+design' (child of 602), text 'Design. user interface and visual design: layout, typography, colour, polish. Web Development. Software Engineering'
definitions.sameLevel2: prediction and reference share the ancestor at level min(2, reference level)
definitions.top3Exact: reference in the 3 best-scoring candidates (flat: global; hierarchical: final decision step)
definitions.margin: flat: top1-top2 score; hierarchical: smallest margin over the decision steps. Scale is per scorer (BM25 is not a cosine)

commands: mkdir -p <work-dir>/pkg && cd <work-dir>/pkg && npm install --save-exact @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5   # once, outside the repository
notRun: held-out split or cross-validation for margin thresholds
